description: (Na)₂TlAlF₆ crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. The structure consists of eight Na clusters inside a TlAlF₆ framework. In each Na cluster, Na is bonded in a 12-coordinate geometry to  atoms. In the TlAlF₆ framework, Tl is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form TlF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent AlF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Tl-F bond lengths are 2.59 Å. Al is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form AlF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent TlF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Al-F bond lengths are 1.83 Å. F is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to one Tl and one Al atom.
